'''A7-X2''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] affiliated with the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] and stationed near the canyons of [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] during the [[Invasion of Ossus]].<ref name="Communication Blackout" />

==Description==
The droid's primary programming was to maintain the enemy's confusion through blocking the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]] from commanding their droids or coordinating their defenses. This was ensured through the dispersion of [[Jammer|signal jammers]] around their communication towers.<ref name="Communication Blackout" />
